This mod is also released with her permission.[/size][/center]

I will try my best to keep up with the original Chinese version, however delays might come due to exams.
- Maddi3

[center]﻿[i]For Setsuko[/i][/center]
[size=4][b][u]Translated Original Description[/u][/b][/size]
Both [b]SMAPI[/b] and the [b]Content Patcher (ending in 1915)[/b] must be updated to their [b]latest versions[/b]!!!
After unzipping, don’t forget to read the [b]“READ ME”[/b] text file.
If you want to know Mizuki’s [b]preferences or schedule[/b], you can download the file with the ID ending in [b]541[/b] for reference.
Currently, there’s only a [b]0-heart event[/b], which is [b]limited to the first year[/b].
It’s [b]recommended to start a new save[/b] and enjoy the experience slowly!
If you’re using an [b]existing save[/b], Mizuki won’t move on the first day after installing the mod — just [b]sleep once in-game[/b], and it’ll be fixed.
Most of the dialogue is [b]randomized[/b].
If you enter a [b]romantic relationship[/b], it’s recommended to date for [b]over a year[/b] — each season has [b]14 lines of 10-heart dialogue[/b].
Also, after marrying Mizuki, you [b]cannot have or adopt children[/b].
[b]Development team[/b] (in order of when they joined the project):
[list]
[*][b]叶玉zz[/b] – did a bit of everything except CGs

[*][b]魔少[/b] – writing, character sprites, and promotional art
[*][b]lost[/b] – CG art
[*][b]Maddi3TheEvil [/b]- EN Translation
[/list]This mod is [b]only released for free on Nexus Mods[/b].
[b]Do not pay[/b] anyone for it!
If you see someone [b]reselling the Mizuki mod[/b], please let me know, thank you.
Reuploads or modifications of the mod are [b]strictly prohibited[/b].

Be sure to [b]read the group announcement[/b] after joining!!!
You can also report bugs in the [b]comments[/b] section.

Downloads.Description:
Fixed some bugs and typos, added the 4-heart event, new dialogues, and a new recipe
It’s recommended to delete the old version before extracting and installing the new one.
This will be the last version for this year. The original author is having exams.
